brief: SaaS panel "Nubo Admin" for managing customers. Layout: navigation sidebar (Customers, Invoices, Settings; Customers active), top bar with the title and a "New customer" button, a row of 4 KPIs (total customers, active customers, billed this month and average ticket, all derived from the data), a CRUD table of customers (name, email, plan and status) with a text filter by name or email and a filter by plan, edit and delete per row, and a create/edit form (name, email and plan; validation: name not empty, email contains @). The view gets the customers with `load()` from `../lib/api.js` (list, create, update, remove; all async). Required states: loading while saving or deleting (button disabled and labeled "Saving…"), error with a message and a Retry button, and a distinct empty state for "no customers" and "no results for the filter". One view with <meta seo>. Accessible (SPEC §8) and using only the available tokens.

files.role: fake in-memory API (plain JS, export default { list, create, update, remove }, async with a 50 ms delay); already provided by the harness, do not rewrite it
KPI card with props label:str and value:str
create/edit form: props client:obj? and busy:bool=false; emits save(data) and cancel
table with filters (text and plan), edit/delete per row (emits edit(client) and remove(id)), a distinct empty state for no data vs no results
the view: <meta seo>, load(), sidebar, top bar, 4 derived KPIs, ClientTable, ClientForm, loading/error states with Retry
